dataset.name: As-filed Schedule A rows
dataset.description: Physical Schedule A itemized-receipt occurrences parsed losslessly from exact electronic filings under the version selected by HDR.

endpoints.name: parent raw electronic filing
endpoints.response_root: ordered physical rows whose field 1 is a Schedule A form type

acquisition.pagination: None inside a document. Process every framed physical record in order; Schedule A selection is a lossless child projection of the already accepted whole document.

partitions.name: efile_received_date
partitions.source: Received-date partition inherited from the selecting listing and parent document.
partitions.purpose: Routine incremental lineage, not contribution time or election-cycle assignment.

partitions.name: header_format_version
partitions.source: Exact HDR field 3 in the parent document.
partitions.purpose: Select the only valid physical layout before field mapping.

acquisition.retry_policy: No independent row retry exists. Reacquire or quarantine the complete parent document when framing, dispatch, byte conservation, or digest checks fail.

physical_schema.encoding: Exact field bytes decoded only under the parent format contract; canonical fixtures contain lossless source text for their ASCII-only rows.
physical_schema.line_ending: Retain the exact parent record terminator, including specified CRLF or observed bare LF.
physical_schema.empty_record_policy: Every selected physical row becomes one canonical occurrence or one explicit row issue. No empty, duplicate, memo, negative, amendment, or malformed occurrence is silently dropped.
physical_schema.null_policy: Canonical empty string means an explicit physical empty field. Canonical null means a logical trailing sequence omitted from the physical row. extra_fields retains every physical field after sequence 45, including empty values.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: contracts/sources/fec/efile-format/v1/schedule-a-fields.json: 45 ordered fields from form_type through account_system_code for HDR versions 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5.

identity.publisher_record_key: file_number + physical_record_ordinal; transaction_id is retained as a report-family assertion, not a globally unique occurrence key
identity.occurrence_locator: parent document SHA-256 + byte_start + byte_end_exclusive + physical_record_ordinal
identity.record_version: occurrence locator + physical record SHA-256 + header format version + layout contract version
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve all physical occurrences. Identical row bytes and transaction IDs across an original and amendment remain distinct source occurrences. Same-file transaction-ID conflicts become validation issues and are never repaired by last-write-wins.

time_fields.meaning: As-filed contribution date in YYYYMMDD when valid; no source time or timezone.
Electronic filing receipt timestamp, independent of contribution date.
Report coverage assertion, independent of contribution and receipt dates.
Legal Tender artifact retrieval and publisher-object metadata time.

money_fields.meaning: As-filed amount for this physical Schedule A assertion. It remains source text until parsed losslessly as a reported point and does not imply countability.
money_fields.unit: USD source AMT-12; common MoneyMeasure reported_point after exact decimal parsing

money_fields.meaning: As-filed contributor accumulator whose period varies by parent form. It is not another receipt to sum.
money_fields.unit: USD source AMT-12; lossless reported accumulator

code_fields.meaning: Schedule A record type and summary-line reference, such as SA11AI.
As-filed contributor entity-type code; not resolved entity identity.
As-filed election code; not the source partition and not a substitute for report coverage.
As-filed memo flag; X means true under the format layout.
As-filed structural references to a related record.

rules: Map fields only after the parent HDR selects a supported version. Preserve unknown versions and rows but emit no normalized Schedule A fact.
The official modification history changes HDR and other forms between 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5 but records no Schedule A layout change; all three dispatch explicitly to the pinned 45-field layout.
Preserve the exact physical row and every decoded source field before validating types or applying domain meaning.
Parse valid money using arbitrary-precision decimal and the common MoneyMeasure contract. Preserve the original text, scale, sign, empty state, and parse issue. Never use binary floating point.
contribution_aggregate is an accumulator. Never add it to contribution_amount or treat it as an independent flow.
memo_code X does not delete the row. A named downstream counting rule decides whether and how it contributes to a total.
Back references and equal amounts can describe related conduit or memo rows. They authorize a structural relationship assertion, not automatic row collapse or terminal-source attribution.

donor_committee fields, conduit fields, contributor names, employer, occupation, and memo text remain separate source assertions. None alone establishes entity identity, employment identity, ideology, economic origin, or terminal source.
A repeated transaction_id across original and amended files is expected by the format's report-life rule and must remain versioned at filing occurrence grain.
Keep contribution date, election code, report coverage, filing receipt, publisher load, artifact observation, and target two-year projection independent.
No as-filed row enters processed reconciliation, effective-report totals, transfer edges, or terminal-source calculations without a separately versioned calculation result.

revisions.publisher_model: Electronic amendments are complete report submissions. The same transaction ID and identical row bytes can recur in an original and amendment, while other rows can be added, changed, or removed.
revisions.effective_projection: Blocked while draft. All original and amendment occurrences publish only as as_filed evidence. A separate effective-report calculation selects a report version and emits row-presence changes without deleting source history.

checks.rule: Each row occurrence retains file_number, parent whole-document digest, header version, ordinal, byte range, record terminator, and physical-row digest.
The exact row fixture or stored raw bytes match physical_record_sha256 and the byte range in the parent artifact.
HDR version is supported and maps to the exact pinned Schedule A layout before canonical fields are emitted.
All physical fields are represented as one of the 45 logical values or in extra_fields; omitted trailing logical fields are null, never fabricated empty strings.
Extra non-empty fields block normalization. Extra empty fields are preserved and reported as observed physical variance.
fields.form_type is a Schedule A record type allowed by the selected layout and associated parent cover form.
Missing, non-uppercase, overlength, or same-file duplicate transaction IDs remain explicit source-validation issues.
Non-empty money text parses losslessly as arbitrary-precision decimal or remains an uncountable parse issue without loss of the source row.
Non-empty contribution date is a valid YYYYMMDD calendar date or remains a time-quality issue without an invented date.
Fixtures prove an identical memo row in an original and its amendment remains two occurrences with different parent digests and byte offsets.

scenarios: same transaction ID across filing versions
distinct document lineage and byte offset
exact physical row including LF terminator
byte-identical row retained as another occurrence

use.retention: Retain exact parent filings, exact row bytes, canonical occurrences, parse issues, and all contract versions indefinitely. A derived current view never deletes or rewrites as-filed evidence.
use.disclaimer: An as-filed Schedule A row is a filer assertion, not a processed FEC record or proof of terminal economic source. Memo, amendment, conduit, report coverage, and later processing rules affect counting and attribution.
